title: Channel & Partnership Manager
html:
Here at Ailytics, we're building AI solutions to envision a safer world. By combining computer vision and predictive analytics, we enable organizations to proactively identify risks, optimize processes, and ultimately save lives. Our platforms are currently deployed all over the world, covering more than 500 million square meters!

We're looking for a Channel & Partnership Manager to join Ailytics and build out our partner ecosystem from the ground up. This is a dedicated role for someone who understands how to identify the right partners and turn early conversations into lasting, productive relationships. If you already have a strong network in the industry, this is for you.

What You Will Be Doing
  • Establish suitable channel partners in target markets, including system integrators, VMS and camera resellers, distributors, and technology partners globally.
  • Own the full partner lifecycle, from recruitment and onboarding through enablement, co-selling, ongoing management, and growth.
  • Build and own partner enablement and training, including certification programs, sales kits, demo environments, and pricing.
  • Maintain warm, productive, and growing partner relationships, supported by regular performance reviews.
  • Represent Ailytics at industry events and partner engagements as needed.
Our Ideal Requirements
  • Prior experience in channel or partnership development, ideally in security, VMS, camera, or related B2B technology spaces.
  • An existing network or the knowledge of relevant connections is a huge plus
  • Ability to operate in an ambiguous and self-driven work environment; comfortable building a partner program without existing frameworks
  • Strong relationship-building and negotiation skills, with the discipline to keep partners engaged over the long run.
Why Work At Ailytics?
  • This is an opportunity to create lasting impact and explore the intersection of AI and safety.
  • We're a start-up that's still in its early stages. If you're looking for an environment where you can really make an impact, this is it.
  • We value strong standards, high transparency, and low ego. Let us know if this sounds like you.
